uncertain.note: The second list is split across the page. Its abbreviations (l. to äfv.) are printed at the right edge of the column-1 strips, and their expansions are in the column-2 strips. To keep reading order (first list complete, then second list), each full 'abbr. = expansion' pair is written in the column-2 strip that holds its expansion: 03 = l.–o., 04 = obj.–rel., 05 = s.–äfv. The abbreviations themselves were read from images 0540_00, 0540_01 and 0540_02.
The last letter of 'mskr' is cut off at the image edge, so it looks like 'mskı'. The expansion '-skor' confirms 'mskr'.
The heading is kept as its own paragraph, followed by one blank line, before the item list.
